approval_required_for: No immediate approval is required for the bounded harness and passive-observability repair.
Explicit approval is required before choosing among ambiguous wrapper identities, Vivado-export contexts, or simulator executables not uniquely supported by current cited evidence.

Explicit approval is required for any architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy, immutable checkpoint/stimulus/reference/tolerance, exact wrapper-source, or lower-layer design-contract change.

consumes: current exact sample-project wrapper and simulation-source hashes discovered by case_board_interface_discovery
current cited Vivado-export compile facts and authorized tool_profile
immutable checkpoint tensor catalog, stimulus provenance, target-model reference outputs, and numeric comparison policy
live hash-validated operator-leaf and single-layer certificates as reusable lower-layer evidence
current case_axi_ddr_interface failure report and active SACG barriers/retry requests as planning-only inputs
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not run VCS through a fallback or guessed board wrapper. Keep current artifacts contaminated, record the unmet exact-board or semantic-contract field, and request a bounded Stage6 verification-contract backtrack or explicit approval if current source identity, Vivado export context, or executable authority cannot be uniquely evidenced.
produces: hash-bound candidate repair record that preserves prior rejected artifacts as history
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the missing and unbound verification capability before diagnosing hardware. Materialize board_tb.sv only from the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and cited current Vivado-export contexts; bind source identity, ordered VCS commands, and executable authority. The board semantic contract must retain the immutable checkpoint, deterministic-or-real stimulus provenance, independently executed target-model expected outputs, frozen numeric policy, generated-testbench hashes, and complete Transformer-block DUT weight-consumption requirements. Add a passive direct-kernel probe without modifying DUT RTL, golden outputs, tolerances, checkpoint, stimulus, or wrapper sources.

consumes: immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, and complete DUT weight-binding requirements
executable_actions.on_failure: If case_axi_ddr_interface fails, return only to exact-board harness/authority repair. If VCS or watchdog evidence fails after the static gate passes, preserve the current hash-bound trace and run repair.classify_current_board_trace before any RTL, loader, runtime, or lower-layer change. Do not promote.
produces: hash-bound current-layer trace provenance and simulator logs
executable_actions.rationale: After the exact-board harness binding passes, rerun the failed current-layer gate and real VCS simulation. The trace must collect cycle-correlated valid, ready, and accepted-handshake counts at direct dut.spatialacc_single_kernel input and output boundaries, plus start/completion lifecycle values in the same adaptive-stall snapshots. This distinguishes no core ingress, accepted-but-unlaunched/retained work, blocked core output, and completed-but-unpropagated output without assuming an RTL root cause.

consumes: active scoped SACG barriers and retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: If trace completeness, source binding, certificate binding, or causal ordering is inadequate, retain the verification-capability blocker and return to repair.rerun_bound_board_interface_and_collect_direct_kernel_trace with only the missing passive observability added. Do not patch a downstream output module or reopen lower layers. If an evidenced lower-layer contract change, rather than a contradiction, is required, request approval before changing that contract.
produces: SACG update preserving the no_lower_layer_challenge decision or recording an explicitly evidenced targeted backtrack request
executable_actions.rationale: Use the first valid current trace to select the narrowest causal repair scope. No direct core ingress or no launch after wrapper acceptance localizes wrapper/control/runtime integration; core egress asserted but wrapper frontier unaccepted localizes the board egress path. A connected-kernel replay is permitted only if the current hash-bound trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate invariant with direct core start, ingress, egress, and named causal-boundary evidence. The existing output-frontier symptom alone is insufficient.

consumes: active SACG contamination barriers and retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140-retry_request.0144
executable_actions.on_failure: Any capability, semantic, numeric, ordering, liveness, AXI, or DDR failure remains a board-layer blocker and routes to the current trace/localization action using fresh tool output. Do not close barriers, alter tolerance or goldens, reuse rejected artifacts as validated inputs, or promote to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime.
produces: fresh artifact.stage7.verification_result candidate with complete current-layer evidence
SACG retry-reconciliation record retaining historical rejected artifacts and promoting no artifact unless all current checks pass
executable_actions.rationale: Only after the exact-board VCS run passes and localization finds no unresolved current-layer failure, execute the remaining board-layer DAG against the same immutable semantic contract. Establish current proof for multilayer functionality, liveness, AXI protocol, DDR image roundtrip, data order, transfer counts, address map, numeric comparison, and assembled semantic evidence. Preserve prior retry/barrier history and submit a new hash-bound candidate that explicitly supersedes prior same-scope retries only after every listed checker passes.

observations: The current board-layer direct failure is real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface: simulation source identity, exact Vivado-export compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and command executable authorization are unbound. functional_sim is dependency-blocked because board_tb.sv is absent; it is not executed VCS, RTL-value, numeric, AXI, DDR, ordering, or liveness evidence.

The current debug closure correctly classifies the issue as a verification_capability_gap with no failed boundary, no root candidate module, and no valid current trace. A hardware RTL patch is therefore unjustified.

The lower operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates are live hash-validated reusable evidence. Connected-kernel timing is certified as an elastic variable-latency token pipeline with required boundary order and cross-token overlap; unequal same-token stage timing is not a failure. No current direct trace contradicts either lower-layer certificate.

Prior repair-execution feedback is usable only to define the smallest required observability: cycle-correlated direct dut.spatialacc_single_kernel ingress/egress valid-ready-accept counts plus kernel start/completion values. It cannot override the current identity-binding failure or establish a hardware failure.

The prior wrapper-ingress-complete/zero-output-frontier symptom is localization evidence only. It neither proves an output/lifecycle pass nor permits reopening the certified connected kernel without current direct-core ingress, start, egress, named causal-boundary, and certificate-contradiction evidence.

sacg_memory_truth reports 15 active scoped contamination barriers and six open scoped retry requests, including retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140-retry_request.0144. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only; a new candidate may supersede them only after all current-stage checks pass and SACG reconciliation is recorded. There are no scoped open backtrack requests.
The conditional design-team router produced no specialist split. Its absence does not replace deterministic checker or real-tool evidence.
proposed_actions: Reconstruct the missing board semantic testbench and canonical VCS plan strictly from the exact discovered sample-project wrapper and current Vivado-export facts; bind every source and executable by hash and preserve the existing target-model/numeric contract.
Add only passive, generated-testbench direct-kernel boundary instrumentation, then rerun case_axi_ddr_interface followed by real VCS and evidence analysis to obtain a current causal trace.
Classify the earliest current-layer boundary from the trace. Keep repair at wrapper/runtime/harness scope unless the trace directly contradicts a hash-bound connected-kernel invariant.

After a passing VCS run, execute the remaining board-layer functional, deadlock, AXI, DDR, ordering, transfer, address-map, numeric, and semantic-evidence gates; only then submit a fresh SACG reconciliation candidate. No backend or board-runtime promotion is authorized now.
risks: Using a guessed wrapper, a simplified AXI/DDR testbench, an unreferenced VCS executable, or stale Vivado facts would repeat the source-identity failure and violate the exact-board requirement.

A board testbench must bind a complete Transformer-block tensor catalog, real target-model expected outputs for the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus, frozen numeric policy, and complete DUT loader-consumption evidence. Embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling must not be added to DUT coverage or golden scope.

Changing checkpoint, input stimulus, target reference, tolerance, generated testbench contract, or exact wrapper-source hashes during this loop would contaminate comparison evidence. Recorded framework defaults may be applied only if the prior policy was initially incomplete, never inferred from DUT output.
A direct-core trace that is incomplete, not hash-bound to the current wrapper/testbench/certificate, or lacks lifecycle and ingress/egress evidence cannot justify a lower-layer backtrack.
Repeated attempts without a new intervention response and current tool evidence risk SACG retry spin. Active barriers must remain until a fresh candidate passes the relevant checks and is reconciled.

If exact user-project identity or Vivado export contexts are genuinely ambiguous, selecting a wrapper, command, executable, model, or path without cited evidence would be an unauthorized board-integration guess.

constraints: exact user-supplied board-wrapper and Vivado-export source-hash binding
immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, tolerance, and testbench contract
complete Transformer-block-only tensor catalog and DUT weight-consumption proof
active SACG contamination barriers are planning-only until a new candidate passes all current checks
edges: immutable checkpoint/stimulus/target-model reference/numeric policy -> board semantic testbench -> case_vcs_functional_sim
case_vcs_functional_sim -> direct_certified_kernel_boundary_probe -> current causal repair context
current causal repair context -> board-wrapper repair OR explicitly evidenced targeted lower-layer backtrack
all current board gates pass -> SACG retry reconciliation -> current-layer promotion eligibility

output.summary: Fail closed at the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system layer. The direct failure is an exact-board verification-capability and source-authority binding failure, not RTL failure: the board testbench is absent and the simulation identity, Vivado-export compile authority, command references, and executable authorization are not bound to the discovered sample-project facts. First repair the immutable exact-board semantic harness and rerun the current-layer boundary trace; do not reopen certified leaf or connected-kernel layers unless the new hash-bound direct-kernel trace explicitly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant.
